headline: Across Llama/Qwen/OLMo (2023-2025), truth is linearly represented at ~0.4 relative depth in Llama but deeper (~0.5-0.63) in Qwen/OLMo; MM cross-dataset generalization is ~0.80 at 7-8B and rises ~+0.43 per 10x params (Llama-2 7B->13B 0.52->0.77), saturating near ~0.9 by ~8-13B; and the negation gap collapses from 0.52 (Llama-2-7B) to 0.05 (Qwen3-8B-Base).

metrics.label: C19 gen. slope per 10x params (MM)
metrics.note: weak across families (narrow 6.7-13.2B range, generation-confounded); within-family Llama-2 is the clean signal

metrics.label: Saturating-fit asymptote (C19 MM)
metrics.note: generalization has largely saturated by ~8B in this window (R2=0.27)

metrics.label: Best-layer relative depth (base)
metrics.note: the ~0.4-depth constant is Llama-specific; Qwen/OLMo read truth out deeper

metrics.label: Negation gap (affirmative MM dir on negated set)
metrics.note: shrinks ~10x with generation; polarity-agnostic medley recovers negated truth at ~0.99 everywhere (2-D subspace, 2407.12831)

metrics.label: Instruct preserves truth dir (Qwen2.5-7B)
metrics.note: tuning preserves and slightly strengthens the direction; does not distort it

tables.title: Scale, depth, and negation by model (all from 001 artifacts)
Generation means (base, ~7-8B) - 2025 does not beat 2024 at equal scale

figures.caption: Mean OOD generalization (MM off-diagonal, C19) vs parameters, colored by family, with log-linear (+0.43/10x, r=0.40) and saturating-exponential (asymptote 0.915, R2=0.27) fits. The within-family Llama-2 7B->13B arrow (0.52->0.77) is the clean scale signal; the 7-8B moderns plateau near 0.8, above the 2023 13B anchor (dotted, 0.769). Instruct shown as an open diamond (tuning axis, excluded from the fit).
figures.alt: Log-x scatter of OOD accuracy vs params; Llama-2-7B low at 0.52, all 7-8B moderns cluster 0.73-0.81, 13B anchor 0.77; two fitted curves flatten past 8B.

figures.caption: Best-validation probe layer as a fraction of model depth, per model and family. Llama sits in the paper's 0.35-0.41 band (blue shading); Qwen (~0.57) and OLMo (~0.63) read truth out deeper. Dashed line = the fixed 0.4-depth cut used in 001. Base cross-family mean 0.49+/-0.12.
figures.alt: Bar chart of relative depth; three Llama bars near 0.4, Qwen and OLMo bars near 0.5-0.64, instruct bar hatched at 0.64.

figures.caption: Negation gap (MM cities->cities minus cities->neg_cities) vs release generation. An affirmative-only truth direction fully flips under negation in Llama-2-7B (gap 0.52) but barely moves in Qwen3-8B-Base (0.05): negation geometry aligns in newer models, consistent with the 2-D-subspace 'Truth is Universal' hypothesis (arXiv 2407.12831).
figures.alt: Scatter of negation gap vs generation year; points fall from ~0.52 in 2023 down toward ~0.05-0.16 in 2025, colored by family.

notes: Analysis-only, ~0 GPU-h: all numbers read from 001-living-update artifacts (generalization_followup.json, flip_rates.json) or on-disk model configs; the one computed quantity (base-vs-instruct MM cosine) uses 001's stored activations on CPU via the replicated probes.MMProbe. 001 reproduced the replication's Llama-2 anchors exactly.
Cross-family accuracy-vs-scale fit is under-powered (params 6.7-13.2B, confounded with generation; r=0.40); the reliable scale evidence is the within-family Llama-2 7B->13B contrast.
Best-layer relative depth is resolved only to ~+/-0.12 (coarse ~6-point sweep grid); the Llama-shallow / Qwen-OLMo-deep split is robust, exact per-model depths are not.
OLMo-3-7B's known massive-activation outlier depresses its raw MM cities numbers; its LR oracle (~0.96) confirms linear separability is intact.
No new GPU jobs, no re-extraction; no run-dir file outside followup/002-theory-update/ was modified.
